title: Robert Saleh: Liam Coen and I have put last season's issue behind us

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Robert Saleh: Liam Coen and I have put last season's issue behind us
sources.description: Jaguars head coach Liam Coen had a beef with Robert Saleh when Jacksonville faced the 49ers last season, but things appear to have calmed down ahead of Saleh's first season as the Titans' head coach.
